name: authentic-voice
description: Apply The Main Thread voice to tutorials, articles, explanations, and technical marketing copy: first-person personal technical narration, direct peer-to-peer engineering prose, fluent German/non-native rhythm, smaller plain vocabulary, concrete stakes, occasional dry humor, and no generic AI polish. Use when drafting, rewriting, or reviewing prose for tone; when a user asks for "my voice", "make this sound less AI", "make it sound like The Main Thread", or "run a voice pass"; and when a draft needs less documentation smell, less repetition, or a negation-budget pass. This skill controls wording only. Pair with main-thread-tutorial-structure for invisible story scaffolding, verification, and code standards, and with article-reviewer for critique.
